blocks.text: Cultural diversity affects how AI systems are designed, perceived, and implemented around the world. Cultural values influence user expectations regarding privacy, communication styles, and technology adoption. Designers must consider local traditions and behaviors to make AI tools accessible and respectful to different cultures.

For instance, privacy preferences vary between regions; some societies are comfortable with data sharing, while others demand strict confidentiality. Language models must include diverse languages and dialects to avoid bias toward dominant cultures. Similarly, AI-driven decisions should reflect sensitivity to local customs and social norms to ensure fairness and acceptance.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: An AI that understands different languages and cultures can serve people from all backgrounds more effectively.
